name: Linear alpha olefins
principle: Ethylene is oligomerised to a range of linear alpha olefins (butene-1, hexene-1, octene-1 up to heavy cuts). SABIC and Linde's alpha-SABLIN is a one-stage homogeneous process; the Jubail plant was contracted in 2004, designed for 150,000 t/yr, and commercialised by 30 November 2009.

source.note: Chemical Processing, SABIC and Linde successfully commercialize linear alpha olefins (30 November 2009)

advantages: Full range of high-purity LAOs (company claim)
limitations: No selectivity data in the article
